svg.title: SciCode cap-rate differences after excluding the 44 recovery-training subtasks. Blue points increase coverage from 10 to 294 retained subtasks with one repetition; green points add repetitions on all 294, reaching 5880 responses per model. Upper shading shows paired-subtask bootstrap 95% confidence intervals; no interval is displayed for subsets with no observed caps. The lower panel shows exact one-sided paired permutation p-values. Repeated attempts stay within subtasks; the analysis assumes independent subtasks.
